reload_notice: Code Viewer: extension list changed. Reload Obsidian (Ctrl+R) to apply.
file_extensions_desc: Comma- or whitespace-separated list of file extensions to open with code viewer. Leading dots optional. Reload Obsidian after changing.
show_line_numbers_desc: Render a gutter with line numbers next to the code.
enable_edit_desc: Show an edit button to modify code files via a temporary markdown file.
edit_open_mode_desc: How to open the editor when clicking the edit button.
